render_mode: headless Chromium DOMContentLoaded plus bounded hydration settle

normalization_rules.tracking_parameters: strip known attribution parameters; preserve functional parameters in observation but exclude query-bearing URLs from corpus identity
normalization_rules.locale: preserve en and zh path segments; record cross-locale edges
normalization_rules.canonical_target: prefer successfully rendered self canonical; never infer missing canonical from slug
normalization_rules.redirects: record final URL and status chain evidence
normalization_rules.case: lowercase scheme and host only; preserve path case and flag noncanonical path case
normalization_rules.url_encoding: WHATWG URL parse and percent-encoding normalization

excluded_url_rules: tracking-only query variants as separate nodes
private_route_observation_policy: Never crawl private routes; redact raw/resolved/normalized private destinations to a PRIVATE_ROUTE_REDACTED category before graph analysis and artifact publication.
retry_policy: Initial attempt plus at most two light retries for timeout, navigation error, or 5xx; never retry stable 4xx.
pause_policy: Stop adding requests when three or more timeout/5xx outcomes occur in the latest twenty completed URLs or when observed latency sharply exceeds the bounded navigation timeout.
resource_policy: Block image, media, and font requests; keep HTML, CSS, and script rendering; do not click, submit, authenticate, start attempts, or warm caches.

internal_authority_proxy.name: FermatMind Internal Authority Proxy
internal_authority_proxy.formula: Iterative damping score over visible crawlable internal links: S_0(v)=1/N; S_{t+1}(v)=(1-d)/N+d*(dangling_mass/N+sum_{u->v} S_t(u)/outdegree(u)); d=0.85; 50 iterations; duplicate source-target links collapsed; computed separately for Full and Contextual graphs.

known_limitations: GSC observed URL export is not available to this task as a live account readback.
A successful rendered crawl observes links but does not make crawler output backend/CMS edge authority.
Blocked image/font/media requests reduce production load and may differ from a fully loaded visual viewport without changing SSR/hydrated anchor enumeration in expected templates.
A timeout, 5xx, or render failure is classified as TRANSIENT_FAILURE and never directly as an orphan.
